French: {"situation": "Asking for directions to the train station", "phrases": [{"english": "Excuse me, where is the train station, please?", "translation": "Excusez-moi, où se trouve la gare, s'il vous plaît ?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "ehk-skew-zay-MWAH, oo suh TROOV lah GAHR, seel voo PLAY?", "note": "Polite way to start asking any local for directions to the station."}, {"english": "Is it far on foot?", "translation": "Est-ce que c'est loin à pied ?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "ehs kuh seh LWAHN ah PYAY?", "note": "Use to figure out if you can walk or need transport."}, {"english": "Which way is it?", "translation": "C'est par où ?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "seh pahr OO?", "note": "Natural phrase when asking someone to point out the direction."}, {"english": "Straight ahead, to the left, or to the right?", "translation": "Tout droit, à gauche ou à droite ?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "too DWAH, ah GOHSH oo ah DWAHT?", "note": "Helpful options to clarify directional gestures."}, {"english": "Can you show me on the map?", "translation": "Pouvez-vous me montrer sur la carte ?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "poo-vay VOO muh mohn-TRAY sewr lah KAHRT?", "note": "Handy when written or spoken directions are getting confusing."}, {"english": "I don't understand, could you speak more slowly, please?", "translation": "Je ne comprends pas, pouvez-vous parler plus lentement, s'il vous plaît ?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "zhuh nuh kohn-PRAHN pah, poo-vay VOO pahr-LAY plew lahnt-MAHN, seel voo PLAY?", "note": "Essential phrase when the local responds too quickly."}], "tips": ["Always start your interaction with 'Bonjour' before asking for directions to be polite.", "In France, 'la gare' specifically refers to a train station, while 'la station' refers to the metro."]}
Spanish: {"situation":"Hotel Check-in","phrases":[{"english":"Hello, I have a reservation under the name...","translation":"Hola, tengo una reserva a nombre de...","romanization":"","pronunciation":"OH-lah, TEN-goh OO-nah reh-sehr-BAH ah NOHM-breh deh","note":"Use when arriving at reception to state your booking name."},{"english":"Here is my passport and booking confirmation.","translation":"Aquí tiene mi pasaporte y la confirmación de la reserva.","romanization":"","pronunciation":"ah-KEE TYEH-neh mee pah-sah-POHR-teh ee lah kohn-feer-mah-SYOHN deh lah reh-sehr-BAH","note":"Hand over your identity documents and confirmation paper or phone screen."},{"english":"What time is breakfast served?","translation":"¿A qué hora es el desayuno?","romanization":"","pronunciation":"ah KEH OH-rah ehs el deh-sah-YOO-noh","note":"Ask about morning meal times and location."},{"english":"What is the Wi-Fi password?","translation":"¿Cuál es la contraseña del Wi-Fi?","romanization":"","pronunciation":"kwahl ehs lah kohn-trah-SEH-nyah del WEE-fee","note":"In Spanish, Wi-Fi is usually pronounced 'wee-fee'."},{"english":"Could you help me with my bags, please?","translation":"¿Me podría ayudar con las maletas, por favor?","romanization":"","pronunciation":"meh poh-DREE-ah ah-yoo-DAHR kohn lah-s mah-LEH-tahs, pohr fah-BOHR","note":"Polite request for luggage assistance at check-in or checkout."},{"english":"I don't understand, could you speak more slowly, please?","translation":"No entiendo, ¿podría hablar más despacio, por favor?","romanization":"","pronunciation":"noh ehn-TYEHN-doh, poh-DREE-ah ah-BLAHR mahs dehs-PAH-syoh, pohr fah-BOHR","note":"Essential phrase when the front desk staff speaks too fast."}],"tips":["It is customary in Spain and Latin America to greet front desk staff with 'Buenos días' or 'Buenas tardes' before stating your booking details.","Most hotels will ask for physical passports or IDs for all guests checking in, as required by local accommodation laws."]}
German: {"situation": "Buying a train ticket at the counter", "phrases": [{"english": "Hello, a ticket to Munich, please.", "translation": "Guten Tag, eine Fahrkarte nach München, bitte.", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "GOO-ten TAHK, EYE-neh FAHR-kahr-teh nahkh MEON-khen, BIT-teh.", "note": "Replace 'München' with your destination city."}, {"english": "Single or return?", "translation": "Einfach oder hin und zurück?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "EYEN-fahkh OH-der hin oont tsoo-RUEK?", "note": "This is what the clerk will ask you."}, {"english": "One-way / Return, please.", "translation": "Einfach, bitte. / Hin und zurück, bitte.", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "EYEN-fahkh, BIT-teh. / hin oont tsoo-RUEK, BIT-teh.", "note": "Use 'einfach' for one-way and 'hin und zurück' for return."}, {"english": "Does the train go directly?", "translation": "Fährt der Zug direkt?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "FEHRT dair TSOOK dee-REKT?", "note": "Ask this to check if you need to change trains."}, {"english": "Which platform does the train leave from?", "translation": "Von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug ab?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "fon VEL-khem GLYES FEHRT dair TSOOK AHP?", "note": "Useful for finding your train track at the station."}, {"english": "I'm sorry, I didn't understand. Could you repeat that?", "translation": "Entschuldigung, das habe ich nicht verstanden. Können Sie das bitte wiederholen?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "ent-SHOOL-dee-goong, dahs HAH-beh ikh nikht fehr-SHTAHN-den. KEU-nen zee dahs BIT-teh vee-der-HOH-len?", "note": "Polite phrase when you need the clerk to repeat something slowly."}], "tips": ["Buying tickets at the counter often incurs a small surcharge compared to using the DB Navigator app or machines.", "Regional trains (RB, RE, IRE) require you to validate printed paper tickets before boarding if not pre-dated."]}
Italian: {"situation": "Buying headache medicine at an Italian pharmacy", "phrases": [{"english": "Hello, I have a headache.", "translation": "Buongiorno, ho mal di testa.", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "bwohn-JOHR-noh, oh mahl dee TES-tah", "note": "Use when entering the pharmacy to state your main symptom."}, {"english": "Do you have something for the pain?", "translation": "Ha qualcosa per il dolore?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "ah kwahl-KOH-zah pehr eel doh-LOH-reh", "note": "Polite way to ask the pharmacist for over-the-counter pain relief."}, {"english": "I would like some paracetamol, please.", "translation": "Vorrei del paracetamolo, per favore.", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "vohr-RAY del pah-rah-cheh-tah-MAH-loh, pehr fah-VOH-reh", "note": "Paracetamol is commonly known as Tachipirina in Italy."}, {"english": "How many times a day should I take it?", "translation": "Quante volte al giorno devo prenderlo?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "KWAHN-teh VOHL-teh ahl JOHR-noh DEH-voh PREHN-dehr-loh", "note": "Ask this to get dosage instructions from the pharmacist."}, {"english": "Do I need a prescription for this?", "translation": "Serve la ricetta per questo?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "SEHR-veh lah ree-CHET-tah pehr KWEHS-toh", "note": "Useful to check if a medicine requires a doctor's prescription."}, {"english": "I don't understand, could you speak more slowly?", "translation": "Non ho capito, può parlare più lentamente?", "romanization": "", "pronunciation": "nohn oh kah-PEE-toh, pwoh pahr-LAH-reh pyoo lehn-tah-MEN-teh", "note": "Use when you need the pharmacist to repeat instructions slowly."}], "tips": ["In Italy, look for a green illuminated cross outside to identify a farmacia.", "Italian pharmacists are highly trained and can recommend remedies directly without a doctor's visit for minor ailments."]}
Tamil: {"situation": "Taking an auto-rickshaw to the bus stand", "phrases": [{"english": "Hello, will you go to the bus stand?", "translation": "வணக்கம், பஸ் ஸ்டாண்டிற்கு வருவீர்களா?", "romanization": "Vaṇakkam, bas stāṇṭiṟku varuvīṟkaḷā?", "pronunciation": "vah-NAHK-kam, bus STAND-ir-ku vah-roo-VEER-gah-lah?", "note": "Polite way to ask if the auto driver is willing to go."}, {"english": "How much for the meter?", "translation": "மீட்டர் போட்டு எவ்வளவு ஆகும்?", "romanization": "Mīṭṭar pōṭṭu evvaḷavu ākum?", "pronunciation": "MEE-ter POH-too ev-vah-lah-voo AH-goom?", "note": "Use to ask for fare based on the official meter."}, {"english": "How much will it cost?", "translation": "எவ்வளவு ஆகும்?", "romanization": "Evvaḷavu ākum?", "pronunciation": "ev-vah-lah-voo AH-goom?", "note": "Use when negotiating a fixed fare before starting the ride."}, {"english": "Please stop here.", "translation": "கொஞ்சம் இங்கே நிறுத்துங்கள்.", "romanization": "Koñcam iṅkē niṟuttuṅkaḷ.", "pronunciation": "kon-jum ING-geh ni-ROOT-thung-gah-l", "note": "Say this politely when you reach your exact drop spot."}, {"english": "Thank you.", "translation": "நன்றி.", "romanization": "Nanṟi.", "pronunciation": "NUN-ree", "note": "Polite sign-off when paying and getting out of the auto."}, {"english": "I don't understand Tamil.", "translation": "எனக்கு தமிழ் புரியாது.", "romanization": "Enakku tamiḻ puriyātu.", "pronunciation": "eh-NAHK-koo thuh-MIZH poo-ree-YAH-thoo", "note": "Use if the driver speaks too fast or asks follow-up questions."}], "tips": ["Always agree on the fare or meter usage before getting into the auto-rickshaw.", "Using ride-hailing apps like Uber or Ola often gives clear fixed pricing in major cities."]}
Korean: {"situation": "Asking for another size in a clothes shop", "phrases": [{"english": "Excuse me.", "translation": "저기요.", "romanization": "jeogiyo", "pronunciation": "juh-gee-YOH", "note": "Use to get a store assistant's attention politely."}, {"english": "Do you have this in a larger size?", "translation": "이거 더 큰 사이즈 있어요?", "romanization": "igeo deo keun saijeu issoeyo?", "pronunciation": "ee-guh duh koon sah-ee-joo eess-uh-YOH?", "note": "Ask when you need a bigger fit."}, {"english": "Do you have this in a smaller size?", "translation": "이거 더 작은 사이즈 있어요?", "romanization": "igeo deo jageun saijeu issoeyo?", "pronunciation": "ee-guh duh jahg-oon sah-ee-joo eess-uh-YOH?", "note": "Ask when you need a smaller fit."}, {"english": "Can I try this on?", "translation": "이거 입어봐도 돼요?", "romanization": "igeo ibeobwado dwaeyo?", "pronunciation": "ee-guh eeb-uh-bwah-doh dweh-YOH?", "note": "Ask before heading to the fitting room."}, {"english": "Do you have a medium size?", "translation": "미디엄 사이즈 있어요?", "romanization": "midieom saijeu issoeyo?", "pronunciation": "mee-dee-uhm sah-ee-joo eess-uh-YOH?", "note": "Replace 'midieom' with 'smar-l' (S) or 'la-jee' (L)."}, {"english": "I'm sorry, I don't understand Korean very well.", "translation": "죄송하지만 한국어 잘 못해요.", "romanization": "joesonghajiman hangugeo jal mothaeyo", "pronunciation": "jweh-song-hah-jee-mahn hahn-gook-uh jahl moh-theh-YOH", "note": "Use if the clerk speaks too fast."}], "tips": ["Clothing sizes in Korea often run smaller than standard US or European sizing.", "Take off your shoes before entering fitting rooms if slippers or a raised platform are provided."]}
Mandarin Chinese: {"situation": "Going through customs at the airport", "phrases": [{"english": "Hello, here is my passport.", "translation": "你好，这是我的护照。", "romanization": "Nǐ hǎo, zhè shì wǒ de hùzhào.", "pronunciation": "nee-HOW, juh-SHUR wor-duh HOO-jaow", "note": "Use when handing your passport to the border official."}, {"english": "I am traveling for tourism.", "translation": "我是来旅游的。", "romanization": "Wǒ shì lái lǚyóu de.", "pronunciation": "wor-SHUR lye LYEW-yo duh", "note": "Standard response when asked for the purpose of your visit."}, {"english": "I will stay for two weeks.", "translation": "我会停留两周。", "romanization": "Wǒ huì tíngliú liǎng zhōu.", "pronunciation": "wor-HWAY ting-LYOW lyahng-JOE", "note": "Replace 'liǎng zhōu' with your specific length of stay."}, {"english": "I have nothing to declare.", "translation": "我没有需要申报的物品。", "romanization": "Wǒ méiyǒu xūyào shēnbào de wùpǐn.", "pronunciation": "wor MAY-yo shoo-YOW shuhn-BOW duh WOO-pin", "note": "Use at the customs green channel if carrying standard luggage."}, {"english": "This is my personal belongings.", "translation": "这些是我的个人物品。", "romanization": "Zhèxiē shì wǒ de gèrén wùpǐn.", "pronunciation": "juh-SHYEH shur wor-duh GUH-run WOO-pin", "note": "Useful if customs officers inspect your bag contents."}, {"english": "Sorry, I don't understand Mandarin Chinese.", "translation": "抱歉，我听不懂中文。", "romanization": "Bàoqiàn, wǒ tīng bù dǒng Zhōngwén.", "pronunciation": "BOW-chyen, wor ting boo-DONG JONG-wen", "note": "Use when an official speaks too quickly or uses complex terms."}], "tips": ["Always complete your Arrival Card legibly before joining the customs queue.", "Keep your hotel confirmation and return flight details printed or easily accessible on your phone."]}
Thai: {"situation": "Reporting a Lost Passport at Police Station", "phrases": [{"english": "Hello, I lost my passport.", "translation": "สวัสดีครับ/ค่ะ ผม/ดิฉันทำหนังสือเดินทางหายครับ/ค่ะ", "romanization": "sawatdee khrap/kha, phom/dichan tham nangsueเดินทาง hai khrap/kha", "pronunciation": "sah-wat-DEE krahp/kah, pohm/dee-CHUHN tuhm nung-sue-daern-tahng HAHY krahp/kah", "note": "Use khrap if male speaker, kha if female speaker."}, {"english": "I need a police report.", "translation": "ต้องการใบแจ้งความครับ/ค่ะ", "romanization": "tong kan bai jaeng khwam khrap/kha", "pronunciation": "taawng KAHN bai JAENG-khwahm krahp/kha", "note": "Essential document needed by your embassy for a replacement passport."}, {"english": "Where is the tourist police station?", "translation": "สถานีตำรวจท่องเที่ยวอยู่ไหนครับ/ค่ะ", "romanization": "sathani tamruat thongthiao yu nai khrap/kha", "pronunciation": "sah-thah-NEE tuhm-RUAHT thaawng-THEAW YOO NAI krahp/kha", "note": "Tourist police speak better English and deal with visitor issues."}, {"english": "I don't understand.", "translation": "ไม่เข้าใจครับ/ค่ะ", "romanization": "mai khao jai khrap/kha", "pronunciation": "MAI khao JAI krahp/kha", "note": "Use when officer speaks too fast or uses complex legal terms."}, {"english": "Can someone speak English?", "translation": "มีใครพูดภาษาอังกฤษได้ไหมครับ/ค่ะ", "romanization": "mee khrai phut phasa angkrit dai mai khrap/kha", "pronunciation": "MEE khrai POOT pah-SAH ahng-KRIT DAI MAI krahp/kha", "note": "Polite way to request an English-speaking officer or translator."}, {"english": "My passport was in this bag.", "translation": "หนังสือเดินทางอยู่ในกระเป๋าใบนี้ครับ/ค่ะ", "romanization": "nangsueเดินทาง yu nai krapao bai nee khrap/kha", "pronunciation": "nung-sue-daern-tahng YOO NAI grah-PAO BAI NEE krahp/kha", "note": "Helpful when describing theft or loss context."}], "tips": ["In major cities, visit the Tourist Police (call 1155) as standard police stations may have limited English speakers.", "Keep a digital copy or photo of your passport bio-page on your phone to speed up filing the police report."]}
